description.en: Welcome to Kaya, a world where dragons shape people's lives. Some people, hunters, make a living by slaying them. Others, shamans, control them with incantations. Seur-Chong is a hunter with the Dragon's Curse, a condition which gives him incredible strength and stamina, but is slowly killing him. A mercenary, he cares only for money. But as he becomes enmeshed in the intrigue surrounding those who hire the hunters, he finds himself fighting for a cause more noble than anything he'd ever imagined. Of course if he's lucky, he just might come away with a profit and a cure to his curse, as well...

An ordinary woman with a freelancing career named Mina encountered a troublesome customer online. It turns out that her troublesome customer is Jinho, her timid and shy next door neighbor. With Mina and Jinho going through personal troubles, will they be able to find solace together?

As if adjusting to high school wasn’t hard enough, the girls find themselves surrounded by prying eyes, rumors, catty schemes, and budding romance. Le Dragon d'Or décide enfin de se laisser aller à l’amusement après une longue période d'abstinence... son entrée à l'académie sous le nom d'« Adrian Heather » le remplit d'une joie fugace, mais cette nouvelle vie prit un tournant inattendu lorsqu'il se retrouva à partager sa chambre avec le plus jeune prince. Juste au moment où il commençait à s'habituer à cette nouvelle dynamique, un imprévu survint, bouleversant ses plans. Il mit alors fin à son escapade, simulant sa propre mort...

Ses journées paisibles, loin des distractions, se voient brusquement interrompues par son invocation dans la chambre du prince !?

Le Dragon d'Or pourra-t-il surmonter cette crise alors qu'il apparaît de nouveau sous la forme  d'Adrian prétendu mort devant le prince, qui lui demande soudainement de retrouver le corps de celui-ci ?

description.en: In the middle of a scuba diving trip in the sea around Malta, Hyun-min finds himself kidnapped to the mythical island Ogygia, where the Greek goddess Calypso is known to reside. Except...Calypso turns out to be a god, not a goddess. Not that Hyun-min cares. He’s going to escape this place and go back to the human realm! Or, well, that’s what he plans to do. But does he really want to leave this island and Calypso behind? Little by little, the two of them find themselves drawn to each other. Can there be a happy ending for a god and a human? Or is this all destined to end in tragedy?

One day, an unidentified flying object appears in the sky along with unknown insect-like monsters. 

A normal high school student, Seungho Yun, is trying to survive as well as find his family. Along the way, he is aided by a message that tells him the future that only appears in his head. As he moves on with that slight advantage, he finds out that there are others who are getting the same message as him. 

Will he be able to find his family? And where are the messages in his head coming from?

In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-u Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster.

Hwa-an, who disguised herself as a man in her older brother's place and joined the army, becoming known as 'General Bi-hong'. However, when she lost her use value, she had to get married as if she had been sold to Heo Ji-hang, the family's fiancé, and was murdered soon after. However, the moment she was close to death, Hwa-an was reborn as a weak girl with the same name. Hwa-an, who dreams of a new life while training himself not to repeat the past, gets involved in a murder case and, as fate would have it, rejoins the army and lives as a soldier...

Note: Derived from a chinese novel, this work received a cdrama adaptation under the title 'Legend of the Female General', released in 2025.

She plays a ‘share house version’ where you can meet various men of various classes all at once. However, she gets wakes up in the game as the female character.

"A lively and always grateful new employee, Min Kyung-jin.
It was the moment he dreamed of a routine office life after joining the top consulting firm <A&Z>.

'Again.'

But the boss he met was Jung Joon-woo, the workaholic head of the Emergency Strategy Planning Team, nicknamed 'Hades.'

'You call this trash a report?'

Joon-woo, who sees people as tools and relentlessly criticizes with aggressive remarks, ends up being the only one left on the team.
Everyone feels sorry for Kyung-jin, who has to endure such a boss as his probationary senior—

'Sorry! I’ll fix it before leaving work!'

As various incidents unfold around them, they find themselves drawn to each other in an unexpected way!

The sweet and eventful office romance drama of Joon-woo and Kyung-jin—no, <Hades and Persephone>—begins!

After two failed engagements and the downfall of her family, Deatrice, the Duke's daughter and once the most celebrated socialite in high society, finds herself in a reluctant reunification with Lucius. Lucius is her former fiance and currently the Emperor's favorite knight whose life had been ruined by her own father six years ago. 

Is this forced marriage the beginning of Lucius' vengeance? Could fate turn it into a second chance for them to get over the shadows of their painful past and find true love?
description.ko:
사위를 왕으로 앉혀 보겠다고 이웃나라에 반정까지 일으킨 아버지의 전략이 실패로 돌아가자, 
데아드라체는 약혼자를 잃는 동시에 가문에 들이닥친 위기를 피하고자 황제가 제일 아끼는 기사와 정략결혼을 하기에 이른다. 
공작의 딸로서 기사와의 결혼이 모욕적인 것이야 그렇다고 쳐도, 그 상대가 문제였다. 황제가 제일 아끼는 기사, 
루시어스 엘리어트는 그녀가 육 년 전 아버지의 반대로 헤어져야 했던 과거의 연인이었던 것이다. 
열정적이고 다정했던 연인이었던 루시어스는 공작의 술수로 사생아라는 것이 밝혀져 작위와 영지마저 잃고, 
데아드라체와도 오해 속에서 헤어진 채 전쟁터로 내몰렸었다. 육 년이 지난 후, 과거의 앙금 속에서 상황이 뒤바뀐 채 서로를 마주하게 되는 두 사람. 
복수인지 미련인지 모를루 시어스의 행동에 데아드라체의 마음은 문드러져 가는데….

description.en:
The ‘Bluebird’s Letter’ exposed noble secrets, ruining families. When debates about its author raged, Kirien Kailos, the ‘Blood Wolf,’ confronted Saint Selene Leclair. 

“I know your secret,” he said, threatening to reveal her authorship unless she came to his mansion alone. 

Troubled, Selene sought advice from past saints. 

“Is he handsome?” they asked. 

“Yes,” she replied. 

“Then go. Life’s too short to miss opportunities."
description.id: Setahun lalu, Surat mencurigakan mulai beredar dikekaisaran artenia, mengungkap rahasia kelam para bangsawan, dan menghancurkan banyak rumah tangga. Disebut sebagai "Surat Blue bird," surat ini menjadi bahan perdebatan tentang siapa sebenarnya penulisnya. Di tengah semua spekulasi, seorang pria mendatangi Selene Leclair, seorang "Saintess" dari Kekaisaran Artenia. "Demi nama Dewi Athenis, saya mengakui dosa saya. Saya berani mengetahui rahasia Anda, Saintess." Pria itu adalah Duke Kirien Kylos, yang dikenal sebagai "Serigala Berdarah." Ia mengancam akan merahasiakan fakta bahwa Selene adalah penulis Surat Blue bird, asalkan Selene datang sendiri ke kastil duke Kylos. Selene pun jatuh dalam kebimbangan. Apa alasan ia harus datang malam-malam ke mansion itu? Apa yang sebenarnya ia rencanakan jika mereka berdua sendirian? Karena tidak menemukan jawabannya, Selene meminta saran dari roh Saintess terdahulu, para kakak seniornya yang menghabiskan hidup di kuil dan menjaga kesucian hingga akhir hayat mereka. Jawaban mereka adalah: "Adik kecil, apa pria itu tampan, ?" "Iya." "Kalau begitu, pergi saja.
description.ko:
그 남자는 「피의 늑대」라고 소문난 키리엔 카일로스 공작. 
그는 셀렌 혼자 카일로스 공작성를 찾아온다면, 
파랑새의 편지를 쓴 사람이 셀렌이라는 사실을 함구하겠다고 협박했다. 

셀렌은 깊은 고민에 빠졌다. 
야심한 밤에 저택으로 오라는 이유가 뭘까? 저택에서 단둘이 뭘 하려고? 
도저히 답을 알 수 없어서, 역대 성녀들의 영혼에 조언을 구했더니. 
대신전에서 평생을 살며 눈을 감는 순간까지 순결을 지켰던 언니들이 이렇게 답했다. 

“막내야. 그 남자 잘생겼니?” 
“네.” 
“그럼 가. 잘 들어. 인생은 못 먹어도 일단 고야.”

description.en: School will bring a fresh start and a way to break free from her seemingly cursed fate. Disaster strikes before she even arrives for her first day at school and a most embarrassing secret is discovered by Chun Hyuk, an aspiring band vocalist who loves only money and music. Can Yu Goon Goon and her best friend, Da-Jung, find a way to shut the mouths of Chun Hyuk and his fellow band members before her high school life is ruined? Da Jung wants to make a deal with the guys but how high a price are the girls willing to pay?

Yo Jang Do is in love with the worlds most perfect man. They wear matching outfits, and she always stops to see him on her way to cram school. There's no reason for her to worry about his status as a popular idol, or that she's really just his obsessive fangirl stalker. No, there are bigger problems for Yo Jang Do. What if her perfect man isn't perfect?

Five childhood friends - Dabin, Jaeha, Taehyeon, Sehui, and Hanbin - make a promise to always stay friends, even after they become adults. Fast forward to the present, where they are now 24-year-olds facing pivotal moments in their journey into adulthood. 

As they face different challenges, the five friends try to carve out their own paths and figure out what they want for the future, lending each other a helping hand or offering a shoulder to cry on along the way. 

And amidst it all, unfamiliar feelings begin to blossom where there was once only friendship…

Dohun Yu has been living in England ever since his family collapsed. One day, Dohun comes to Korea almost forcefully without proper preparation. Don't ask me why, but I think it's his personality. (He does do things without planning anyway). Dohun loses his bag as he arrives in Seoul (the capital city of Korea) along with all his money. He comes completely moneyless within a day. A week later, he encounters an ad where it said "Seeking a friend! Paying well…yada yada blah blah, girl only!". Still having his suitcase which was confused with his sister's, he had girl's clothes. Having no other choice, he applies.  
  
NOTE: This series was abandoned by the author at 4 volumes, with the story incomplete.

Marissa is admired by all of the men at Dawa University, including the popular Shin Shim-hae . However, her eyes are set on Lee Dae-sung, the only man who doesn't seem to care for her. Follow a tale of unrequited love as Risa tries to finally win Dae-seong's attention!

Kang Yohan rises to fame as the first judge to preside a nationally broadcasted trial.

With his decisive judgement and good looks, he is lauded a hero to bring much-needed change in the Korean justice system.

However, his junior judge Kim, Ga-on, finds something amiss about Yohan... whose sociopathic tendencies suggest he may be not entirely what he seems...

Is Kang Yohan a truly heoric judge as the people think? Or is he just a devil in disguise?

description.en:
“You should be given a chance to take revenge before dying.”

With that softly muttered sentence, my heart dropped. The warmth was no longer felt in the hands that gripped my head.

“…I thought you were dead.”

A smile flickered across the cold face. A sense of relief that the opportunity for revenge was not lost. A sense of triumph for not losing the prey. He possessed a refined arrogance and a beautiful cynicism, instead of clumsy innocence and cumbersome affection. Much had changed, and so had she.

“As much as you have fallen, I have risen.”

I was so accustomed to enduring pain. But enduring pleasure and desire was unfamiliar.

“I want to carve it out. All the memories of that night.”

So, I ran away, carrying his child.

description.en:
“I need you to have an affair with me.”

To break off his forced engagement with the princess, the wealthy Duke Leopold Otero von Bern stages a perfect affair scam.

Violetta Hernandez is a fallen noble who became an affair consultant after all her previous lovers cheated on her for that very same princess. She barely manages to make a living on consultation fees from her clients. But one day, she receives a a notice to repay a massive family debt and finds herself in a desperate situation where she must urgently raise tuition for her younger brother…

“Tuition? I’ll cover your brother’s future too.”

“What about my future? Once I’m branded as a mistress, marriage is a fantasy.”

All she had ever dreamed of was a loving marriage—just enough to eat and live happily. Is becoming his “mistress” really the answer?

“I’ll make sure we don’t get caught. Just leave enough traces… something the princess will completely misunderstand.”

And so begins the affair scam. The man who promised to only pretend to cheat keeps crossing the line.

“You really think this flimsy evidence will convince anyone?”   
“I came to get my money’s worth.”  
“Show some sincerity, even if it means leaving a mark.”

…Looks like she's gotten tangled up with the wrong guy.

전 연인들이 황녀와 바람피워 헤어진 덕에 
외도상담가가 된 몰락 귀족, 비올레타 헤르난데즈. 

그녀는 의뢰인들의 상담비로 겨우 생계를 유지해 간다. 
하지만 어느 날 가문이 진 거액의 채무이행서를 받게 되고, 
남동생의 학비마저 급히 마련해야 하는 상황에까지 닥치는데……. 

“학비쯤이야, 남동생의 앞날까지 책임져 주지.” 
“제 앞날은요? 바람녀 딱지 붙으면 결혼은 꿈도 못 꿔요.” 

그저 밥 먹고 살 정도의 사랑 가득한 결혼을 꿈꿨건만. 
정녕 그의 바람녀가 되는 게 답인 걸까. 

“들키지 않게 해줄게. 흔적만 남겨. 황녀가 완벽히 오해할 만한.” 

그렇게 시작된 대국민 외도 사기극. 
바람피우는 척만 한다던 남자는 자꾸만 선을 넘어온다. 

“이따위 증거들이 통할 거로 생각하나?” 
“돈 값하러 온 거라며.” 
“키스 자국이라도 남기는 성의를 보이든가.” 

아무래도… 그에게 잘못 걸린 것 같다.

Dire que ma femme, que je croyais si ordinaire, était en fait une tueuse ?!

Un jour, après avoir découvert la liaison de sa femme, 'Iman' est persuadé qu'elle cherche à l'éliminer et décide de la tuer en premier.

Cependant, sous ses propres yeux, Iman assiste au meurtre de sa femme par un inconnu, et devient simultanément la cible d'assassins...

C'est alors qu'entre en scène 'Cinéphile', un tueur engagé pour protéger Iman.

Pour survivre, et pour découvrir qui était sa 'véritable' femme, il doit retrouver le coupable qui l'a assassinée !

Une histoire de vengeance et d'action spectaculaire mettant en scène ce duo fraîchement formé !

It's Okay to be Shy is a story about a man and a girl who have an “opposite” personality of their gender. Hyo Jin is a freshman who has more female friends than male friends. He is a bit of a crybaby and is more feminine than masculine. Dam is a sophomore who has more male friends than female friends. She is the opposite of a stereotypical girl and is more masculine than feminine. It’s based on true stories including the author's own experiences.

From Konnichiwa:  
Suh Yeon Oong, a laid back guy. Has a broken family and now living with his father. Is a spunky chick-boy type of guy that easily wins hearts of girls..until he saw another fine looking gal named Daji. Meanwhile, another person appeared into Suh Yeon's life which was his childhood enemy/friend. Who is that girl? And why can't he remember her?

3) Conspiring with the Enemy: Out on a group date, Myunghae fights with a gangster…only to learn the next day that the man she quarreled with is also her new math teacher!
Every day, my way.

description.de: Als Ceriniel herausfindet, dass ihre beste Freundin und ihr Ehemann sie hintergangen und betrogen haben, ist sie am Boden zerstört. Nicht nur haben die beiden ein Kind und ein eigenes Anwesen miteinander – ihre ehemals beste Freundin hat ihr außerdem über Jahre hinweg Gift eingeflößt, um sie langsam, aber sicher zu töten. Auf dem Sterbebett betet Ceriniel um eine zweite Chance ... und wacht prompt in der Vergangenheit wieder auf. Für ihren Racheplan hofft sie auf eine vorübergehende Zweckehe mit dem blutrünstigen Kriegshelden Herzog Lexion, der sie aus irgendeinem Grund nie aus den Augen zu lassen scheint. Der gut aussehende Herzog willigt ein, Ceriniel zu helfen – aber stellt seine ganz eigene Bedingung: eine richtige Ehe ohne Ablaufdatum.
description.en: Ceriniel is heartbroken when she learns her husband has been cheating on her with her best friend and secretly poisoning her for years. But when she dies and wakes up in the past, she's determined to get revenge on those who betrayed her. And so she bravely seeks the help of the bloodthirsty war hero, Duke Lexion Rosenvester, who was oddly kind to her in her past life. His only conditions are that she ditch her unfaithful husband and enter a permanent marriage with him instead...!
description.fr: Brisée en découvrant que son mari la trompe avec sa meilleure amie et l’empoisonne depuis des années, Ceriniel finit par mourir… pour mieux se réveiller dans le passé. Décidée à se venger, elle se tourne vers le redoutable duc Lexion Rosenvester, héros de guerre réputé pour sa cruauté, mais étrangement bienveillant à son égard dans sa vie précédente. Cependant, son aide a un prix: abandonner son époux infidèle et accepter un mariage éternel à ses côtés…
description.id: Ceriniel patah hati ketika mengetahui suaminya telah berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya dan diam-diam meracuninya selama bertahun-tahun. Namun, ketika ia meninggal dan terbangun di masa lalu, ia bertekad untuk membalas dendam kepada orang-orang yang mengkhianatinya. Maka, ia dengan berani mencari bantuan pahlawan perang yang haus darah, Duke Lexion Rosenvester, yang anehnya baik padanya di masa lalu. Satu-satunya syaratnya adalah ia harus meninggalkan suaminya yang tidak setia dan menikah dengannya selamanya...!
description.it: Il marito che amava, l'unico e solo migliore amico di cui si fidava. Ma sull'orlo della morte, Seriniel capì la verità. Tutto era una cospirazione intessuta di bugie e tradimenti. In quel momento, l'amore si trasformò in odio e lei giurò vendetta. Sull'orlo della disperazione, colui a cui si rivolse fu il duca temuto come il “Cane dell'Imperatore”, spietato e senza pietà, che elimina chiunque si opponga all'autorità imperiale: Lexion Rosenwester. Un uomo più freddo e pericoloso di chiunque altro al mondo. Le condizioni che lui le pose per aiutarla erano solo due: “La prima è che tu abbandoni completamente quell'uomo inutile. E la seconda è...” Così ebbe inizio il pericoloso contratto tra i due. Ma lei non aveva dubbi. La seconda vita di Seriniel era iniziata solo per vendicarsi.

Mas, ao morrer e acordar no passado, ela está determinada a se vingar daqueles que a traíram. Por isso, busca corajosamente a ajuda do sanguinário herói de guerra, o Duque Lexion Rosenvester, que foi estranhamente gentil com ela em sua vida passada. A única condição para ele é que ela abandone o marido infiel e se case com ele para sempre...!

After losing her older sister and brother-in-law in a hit-and-run accident, Jung Yuna has been raising her niece, Jian, while living a strong and independent life as a working aunt. One day, Kang Iden takes over as the new CEO of the asset management company where Yuna works.

From their terrible first meeting to the endless embarrassing mistakes she keeps making, Yuna finds herself caught in a series of humiliating moments ever since she met Iden.
Meanwhile, Iden, who needs a family for his business in the Middle East, proposes that Yuna and Jian become his fake family.

description.en:
Selena's whole world is turned upside down when Sienna, the daughter of a maid, suddenly claims that she's the real daughter of Count Estarion.

Sienna remembers everything about Selena's childhood, making everyone believe that she's the real daughter. Her once supportive brother and father, who are everything to her, turn cold and kick her out of the house. Even her close friend and fiancé turn their backs on her. 

With nowhere to go, she is saved by the only person who treats with her kindness, Eideun Calypso, a war hero who was once a lowly slave. He asks Selena to be his private tutor and teach him high society etiquette. 

Why is Eideun being so generous to her? Will Selena be able to find out the truth about her identity? Will she take revenge on those who betrayed her trust?
description.fr: La vie de Séléna se retrouve chamboulée le jour où Sienna, une jeune femme qui lui ressemble comme deux gouttes d'eau, se présente au domaine Estarion en clamant être la véritable fille du comte. Alors que Séléna n'a plus aucun souvenir de son enfance, Sienna, elle, se souvient de tout. Très vite, Séléna est jetée dehors. Abandonnée par tous et n'ayant nulle part où aller, elle est accueillie par Ayden Calypso, un ancien esclave devenu héros de l'empire, qui lui propose un contrat pour s'entraider. Entre la gentillesse inexplicable du duc et la trahison de ses proches, Séléna parviendra-t-elle à découvrir qui elle est réellement? Et pourra-t-elle se venger de ceux qui l'ont trahie?
description.ja:

'진짜 딸'이라고 주장하는 시에나가 등장하는 순간 모든 게 바뀌었다. 
가족과 친구는 등을 돌렸고, 사랑했던 약혼자는 나를 조롱했다. 

그런 내게 다가온 단 한사람.  
천한 노예 출신의 전쟁영웅 에이든 칼립소. 

그는 사교계 예절 선생이 필요하다며 내게 가정교사가 되어 달라 제안한다. 

"힘들면 내게 기대. 혈통 좋은 나무는 되지 못해도  
비바람을 막아주는 수풀은 되어줄 수 있으니까." 

그제야 깨달았다. 

가정교사가 되어 달라 한 건 모두 구실이었음을.  

그는 처음부터 나를 원했던 거였다.

description.en:
I not only reincarnated into someone who died in an absurd fashion, but I also took the crown prince's place and went to the secret neutral territory, where male members of the five imperial families gathered. As a result... my childhood friends know me as a boy.

“Goodbye, guys." I cried in front of my friends who I would never meet again. That was because officially, I (the prince) was going to die soon!

It was fun spending time with them, but I will never see them again. I hope everyone lives happily!

====

After many years, my childhood friends turned heroes who defeated the wild dragon visited me.

『프린세스 안나』로 한국만화문화대상 출판만화부문 신인상, 2000년 문화관광부 주관 오늘의 우리만화상 대상 등을 수상한 변병준 작가의 신작이다. 어둡고 우울한 느낌의 전작에 비해 훨씬 따뜻해진 내용과 색채가 눈에 띈다. 아름답고 고요한 해남의 바다 풍경, 엷은 무채색의 도심풍경 등 수채화 같은 그림과 동화 같은 이야기가 어우러진 만화.

돈을 벌기 위해 상경한 뒤 소식이 끊긴 남편을 찾으러 해남에서 무작정 상경한 여인과 그의 아들 봉구. 그 둘에게 서울 거리는 무심하고 건조한 곳이다. 막막한 심정으로 바라본 도심의 풍경. 그리고 그 안에서 살아가는 인간의 모습. 이야기는 희망적인 메시지를 전하며 해피엔딩으로 끝을 맺는다.

일본풍이 아닌, 자기만의 그림을 그리고 싶다는 작가의 열정이 묻어나는 작품이다.
